Email Marketing Guide for Small Businesses

This email marketing guide shows small businesses how to plan, write and send emails that earn clicks, replies and sales. You will learn how to build an email list, set up automation and measure open rate.

What is email marketing?

Email marketing is the use of email to promote products and build relationships with customers, leads and subscribers over time, with permission.

How to build an email list

Place sign-up forms where visitors already read, offer a lead magnet and confirm every subscriber with double opt-in, so the email list stays healthy and your emails reach the inbox.

Email automation workflows

Automation lets small businesses send a welcome email, an abandoned cart reminder and a win-back campaign without manual work, while segmentation keeps each message relevant.

Email segmentation basics

Group subscribers by interest, purchase history or engagement. Segmentation improves open rate and click rate, and reduces unsubscribes from irrelevant campaigns.

Legal basics: consent and unsubscribe links

Collect consent, include an unsubscribe link and a physical address in every email, and honour opt-out requests promptly to follow anti-spam rules.

How often should you send marketing emails?

Start weekly, then adjust based on engagement, unsubscribe rate and the type of content you share with your subscribers.
